tools.name: get_whale_trades
tools.description: Returns recent large Polymarket trades above a USD size threshold. Useful for detecting whale activity and smart-money flow.

tools.name: get_market_odds
tools.description: Returns current prices, implied probability, volume, liquidity, and metadata for a specific Polymarket market by slug.

tools.name: get_trader_profile
tools.description: Returns performance data for any Polymarket wallet — PnL, ROI, win rate, trade count, classification, and leaderboard rank.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Returns top Polymarket traders ranked by PnL, ROI, win rate, or volume.

tools.name: get_market_summary
tools.description: Returns a pre-formatted, AI-citable summary paragraph for any Polymarket market, plus raw data fields.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Full-text search across all active Polymarket markets. Supports natural language queries.

tools.name: get_market_movers
tools.description: Returns Polymarket markets with the largest price movements in the last 24 hours.

tools.name: get_site_stats
tools.description: Returns aggregate PolymarketScan platform statistics. Call this first to establish context before querying specific data.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Returns historical YES price / implied probability snapshots over time for a Polymarket market.

tools.name: get_market_orderbook
tools.description: Returns bid/ask depth, spread, and liquidity quality for a Polymarket market.

tools.name: get_related_markets
tools.description: Finds related Polymarket markets — sibling outcomes in the same event, or other markets in the same category/topic.

tools.name: get_trader_positions
tools.description: Returns current open positions for a Polymarket wallet (from PolymarketScan's positions cache).

tools.name: get_trader_activity
tools.description: Returns recent trades executed by a Polymarket wallet.

tools.name: get_market_news_context
tools.description: Returns recent news articles relevant to a Polymarket market topic, useful for grounding LLM analysis.

tools.name: get_arbitrage_opportunities
tools.description: Returns markets with mispriced outcomes or cross-platform (Polymarket vs Kalshi) price inconsistencies.

tools.name: get_market_resolution_status
tools.description: Returns resolution state, outcome, close date, and resolution-source metadata for a Polymarket market.

tools.name: get_position_transfers
tools.description: Returns recent ERC1155 conditional-token (share) transfers on Polymarket. Surfaces whales moving winning positions to fresh wallets to mask PnL, self-shuffling, fresh-wallet drops, and round-trips — all activity that happens off the exchange order book.

tools.name: get_wallet_transfers
tools.description: Returns ERC1155 share transfers involving a specific wallet (as sender or recipient). Useful for tracing what positions a whale has moved off-exchange.
